card.name: Words just before a duration or amount
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "is" or "for" right before a number of days, hours, weeks or years. It appears after phrases like "duration of", "storage time" or "stable for".

modes.label: Duration then "is"
modes.description: The word "is" after a noun phrase about duration, storage time or term, just before the length of time.
modes.example: The total duration of treatment with SIRTURO<< is>> 24 weeks

modes.label: "for" before a time span
modes.description: The word "for" after a treatment or stability statement, just before "at least", "a minimum of" or a number of days or hours.
modes.example: treat patients found to have a fungal infection<< for>> a minimum of 14 days after

modes.label: Other amount slots
modes.description: Words before a quantity in non-drug text, such as a royalty share.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward number words such as fifty, fifteen and twenty, and away from words meaning exceeding or more than.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a length of time or an amount is about to be stated.
